meaning.en: Difficulty in speaking, usually evidenced by hoarseness.
meaning.vi: Khó khăn khi nói, thường được thể hiện bằng chứng khàn giọng.

meaning.en: Impairment of the ability to produce speech sounds, as because of hoarseness.
meaning.vi: Suy giảm khả năng tạo ra âm thanh lời nói, như vì khàn giọng.

meaning.en: Difficulty in speaking, usually evidenced by hoarseness.

meaning.en: (medicine) A difficulty in producing vocal sounds.
meaning.vi: (y học) Khó khăn trong việc tạo ra âm thanh.
